# [v0.92.2][ARCH-ADR] Complete the milestone architecture decision record set

## One complete result

Deliver one complete source-grounded v0.92.2 ADR set and supersession map. Reconcile every required decision across the final 69 issue identities with explicit owner, alternatives, consequences and actual decision status. This does not implement architecture or silently accept candidate text.

## Owned surfaces

Start with `docs/milestones/v0.92.2/ADR_PLAN_v0.92.2.md`, current design/contracts and final issue wave. Candidate material belongs under `docs/architecture/adr/`; accepted ADR authority remains `docs/adr/` as documented by `docs/architecture/adr/README.md`. Reuse the current ADR template/numbering/index contract after inspection; do not invent accepted record numbers. Keep the source inventory, dispositions and supersession map in the milestone ADR packet and update necessary candidate/index references.

## Acceptance

1. Reconcile the seed candidates against all admitted tasks, including split ingestion/architecture/governance/review/action-planning/rendering, provider lifecycle, Memory Palace and C-SDLC simplification decisions. Every required decision has an explicit record or a reasoned reference to an existing authoritative decision.
2. Each complete ADR includes the concrete decision question, context, alternatives, consequences, reversibility, source/revision references, accountable owner and status. Conflicting inputs remain visible and receive a recorded disposition; missing rationale is not invented.
3. Preserve proposed, accepted, rejected, deferred and superseded distinctions. Acceptance requires actual operator/decision-owner authority; implementation or a green validator cannot manufacture it. A finished candidate can be a truthful record, but an unresolved required decision must stay explicitly unresolved in milestone accounting.
4. Link superseded/superseding records without rewriting historical accepted bytes. Validate template structure, source links, inventory completeness, status/authority and reciprocal supersession as applicable. Retain independent review and resolve actionable documentation defects.
5. Deliver the full set, not an ADR-writing plan. ARCH-ADR remains one of seven required planning tasks; its completed decision-set acceptance gates TAIL-10, without adding early CF-INTEGRATE or TAIL-01 dependencies.

## Dependencies and global start gate

Execution prerequisites: WP-01, with accepted required outputs before dependent execution. OBS-LIVE is existing #720. Preserve any external foundation dependencies stated above and in the issue wave; no replacement of completed predecessor work.

All 69 milestone issue identities must be created and every creation-batch review must pass before any implementation starts. Batch grouping itself adds no execution dependency. Creation/review is distinct from implementation, deployment, manuscript publication and milestone closure.

## Complete specification coverage

- Acceptance obligations: all_required_decisions_inventoried, every_adr_source_grounded, status_and_owners_explicit, alternatives_and_consequences_recorded, superseded_decisions_linked, no_decision_claimed_accepted_without_authority.
- PVF obligations: adr_template_validation, source_link_check, decision_inventory_reconciliation, status_and_supersession_check.

## Verification and truthful evidence

Use the smallest proving checks for the actual result: source/structure/link/redaction and completeness validation for documents/inventories; real read-only cloud observations for inventories; actual authorized deployment/readback/browser evidence for OBS-S3; full revised prose and source/citation/editorial review for publication preparation. No schema/template/outline or unrelated green CI substitutes for the result. Preserve exact source revisions, observation times and explicit not-run/not-proven outcomes.

PVF classification: deterministic local document/contract checks are local CPU and required issue gates, with source/identity/redaction negatives as applicable. Cloud readback, Terraform plan and browser/live-service checks are separate external-resource lanes with exact approved environment and evidence scope; do not label them deterministic offline proof. OBS-S3 live application has its explicit approval boundary. New tests record lane, proof role, determinism, resource profile and release-gate status in the tightly coupled manifest. Obtain independent review before publication; local structural checks alone do not establish content truth.

## Non-goals, authority and stops

Retain exclusions: implementing_architecture, approving_adrs_without_operator_authority, rewriting_historical_adrs. Stop conditions: unsupported_architecture_claim, missing_decision_owner, hidden_implementation_scope, accidental_acceptance_of_candidate. Treat missing execution authority, ownership collision, incomplete required evidence and privacy exposure as explicit blockers.

Use native C-SDLC v3 with current authenticated authority and an issue-bound FastWork worktree/session goal for ADL work; root main stays inspection-only. Preserve inherited edits and historical evidence. Cloud/provider/account changes, infrastructure application and external publishing require their own explicit execution authority; creation alone supplies none. Do not print credentials, state secrets or private manuscript content. All seven planning tasks remain required and their completion is distinct from implemented Beta functionality.

## Source basis

`docs/milestones/v0.92.2/WP_EXECUTION_SPECIFICATIONS_v0.92.2.yaml`, `ATOMIC_TASK_CONTRACTS_v0.92.2.json`, `CREATION_SELECTIONS_v0.92.2.md`, `ADR_PLAN_v0.92.2.md`, and the concrete source surfaces above. Resolve current source/ownership before execution; these issue bodies do not claim the described work has already happened.

Execution prerequisite: #864 (WP-01); accepted output is required before dependent execution.
